notes: Owner UX directive (2026-08-05): one top-level Administration tab; Settings and Processes stop being top-level tabs and become panels behind a left-hand menu — room for the customizations and utility capabilities that are visited to configure, not to research. The registry is the extension point (server/terminal.js). ADMIN_PANELS — settings (⚙) and processes (🔄) — drives the left rail (the Market-tab rail pattern) and the content dispatch (ADMIN_RENDER): a future utility panel is ONE registry entry plus ONE renderer, nothing else to wire. The selected panel persists in state.admin.panel like
